messages.subject: scale.model=TRUE
parts:
Dear all, 
I have a question related to scale.model function, I am trying to run a BYM2 model in INLA with the scale.model=TRUE but I am getting an error. I guess that this option is not developed for this model, but I am not sure since I am getting the same error using model="generic1".

formula <- Obs ~ 1 + f(ID, model="bym2",graph=Limburg.INLA,
                       scale.model=TRUE, constr=TRUE, scale.model=TRUE)

BYM2.model <- inla(formula,family="poisson",
                   data=Data.Inla, E=Data.Inla$Exp,
                   control.predictor = list( compute = TRUE ),
                   control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,  waic=TRUE ) )

formal argument "scale.model" matched by multiple actual arguments

Thank you in advance :)

You have written scale.model = TRUE twice within the f() call.
